note: Championships won as a PLAYER by people who also appear on staff. Kept separate from staff rings — the leaderboard ranks staff rings, and a player ring shows as a badge. Filled by scripts + research; see docs/data-pipeline.md.

players.name: Rob Ezell
players.detail: Walk-on quarterback/wide receiver at Alabama 2007-2010, on the roster for the 2009 BCS title, then returned as an analyst.

players.name: Thad Turnipseed
players.detail: Played for Alabama 1990-92 and was on the 1992 national championship roster, then came back as a staffer — running facilities and football external affairs under Saban before joining Clemson.

players.name: William Vlachos
players.detail: Starting center at Alabama 2008-2011 — blocked for Mark Ingram's Heisman season — and on the roster for the 2009 and 2011 titles. Came back as a graduate assistant and offensive analyst, adding 2015 and 2017 on staff. Four Alabama rings, two of each kind.
